children: Automated global broker's Q3 revenue rose and beat analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 missed analyst expectations
Company raised quarterly dividend to $0.15 per share
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year
NET INTEREST INCOME - Co said net interest income rose 19% due to higher average customer margin loans and customer credit balances
TRADING ACTIVITY - Co said commission revenue grew 12% on increased futures trading volume and higher daily average revenue trades, while stock and options volumes declined
OTHER FEES - Co said other fees and services rose 33%, mainly from higher risk exposure fees, payments for order flow, and market data fees
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 14 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the investment banking & brokerage services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Interactive Brokers Group Inc is $106.80, about 26.9% above its October 14 closing price of $84.14
The stock recently traded at 27 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 32 three months ago
